assembly.name: Engine — ancillaries, lubrication & mounts
assembly.description: The dossier §2 items the coverage audit caught: the serpentine FEAD belt on the accessory end driving the alternator and A/C compressor (note — the coolant pump is NOT on this belt, it's balance-shaft driven), the starter, oil pan, valve cover with the failure-prone PCV diaphragm, coil-on-plug ignition, and the three-point engine mounting with its dossier torques.

parts.name: Oil pan / sump
parts.description: Sump under the ladder frame; the oil pump and pickup live inside (internals not modelled yet). Dossier §2 failure list notes oil-cooler/filter-housing weeps and rear-main-seal seeps as known EA888 drips.
knownIssues: Oil-cooler / filter-housing weeps and rear main seal seeps are on the dossier's known-issues list (§2)

parts.name: Valve cover with integrated PCV
parts.description: Cam cover with the crankcase-ventilation diaphragm built in (dossier §2). A torn PCV diaphragm is a classic all-generations EA888 fault: rough idle, boost/vacuum codes, oil consumption. The AVS actuators and ignition coils mount through it.
knownIssues: PCV diaphragm tears → rough idle, boost/vacuum faults, oil consumption (dossier §2 failure list). Whistle from the cover is the classic symptom.

parts.name: Ignition coils (coil-on-plug) ×4
parts.description: Pencil coils down the plug wells, one per cylinder (dossier §2 ignition). Firing order 1-3-4-2.

parts.name: FEAD serpentine belt, pulleys & tensioner
parts.description: Single serpentine belt on the accessory end with automatic tensioner, driving the alternator and A/C compressor only — the EA888 Gen 3's coolant pump is driven off a balance shaft instead (dossier §2, an easy trap when tracing the belt).

parts.name: Alternator
parts.description: Belt-driven alternator with energy-recuperation logic for the start-stop system (dossier §7 battery/charging).

parts.name: A/C compressor
parts.description: Belt-driven A/C compressor low on the accessory end; its refrigerant lines join the HVAC loop in Phase 7 (dossier §8).

parts.name: Starter motor
parts.description: Starter on the block/bellhousing flange, pinion engaging the flywheel ring gear inside the DSG bellhousing (dossier §2).

parts.name: Engine mount, right (hydraulic)
parts.description: Right-side hydraulic (pendulum-type) engine mount on the accessory end, to the body rail. Dossier §2 torques: mount-to-engine-bracket ~60 Nm +90°, mount-to-frame-rail ~40 Nm +90°.

parts.name: Transmission mount, left
parts.description: Left-side mount on top of the DQ250 case to the body rail — the second point of the three-point transverse mounting (dossier §2).

torqueSpec.note: Same MQB mount torque family as the engine side (dossier §2)

parts.name: Dogbone / pendulum support mount
parts.description: The lower torque arm from the gearbox down to the front subframe — third point of the mounting triangle, taking drive-torque rock (dossier §2). The classic first upgrade for sloppy-feeling shifts.
